meta.title: Vietnam vlog 1 🛵 Ho Chi Minh, Mekong Delta and Hoi An
meta.description:
Join us on our Vietnam trip from South to North. A country of great food, amazing coffee, lush greenery, colourful cities, lanterns, culture and history. 🪷🛵🇻🇳

In this video we visit the cafe apartments, make our own jewellery, experience basket boats and try unreal coffee!! ☕️

This vlog covers Ho Chi Minh City/Saigon, the Mekong Delta, Da Nang and Hoi An ➡️ stay tuned for part 2 covering Nimh Binh, Ha Long Bay and Hanoi.
